user.title: Connect Home Assistant to 小艺
user.description: Enter the AK/SK credentials and Agent ID of an OpenClaw-mode agent created on the [小艺开放平台]({docs_url}). The credentials are verified against the XiaoYi servers before the entry is created.

data_description.ws_url2: Second endpoint for high availability; leave empty to use the default
data_description.ak: Key shown once when the credential is created on the 小艺开放平台
data_description.sk: Secret key shown once when the credential is created
data_description.agent_id: Agent ID of the OpenClaw-mode agent

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect 小艺 credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for agent {agent_id} stopped working. Create a new AK/SK pair on the 小艺开放平台 (the old pair is invalidated immediately) and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change XiaoYi server endpoints
reconfigure.description: Update the WebSocket endpoints used for agent {agent_id}. The new endpoints are verified before they are saved.

error.missing_required: AK, SK and Agent ID are all required
error.invalid_url: Not a valid WebSocket URL (must start with ws:// or wss://)
error.invalid_auth: The XiaoYi servers rejected these credentials (check AK/SK and that the agent is published)
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the XiaoYi servers right now

abort.already_configured: This Agent ID is already configured

init.title: XiaoYi Bridge options
init.description: Tune how voice commands are processed. Changes reload the bridge, so it reconnects once.

data.single_server: Connect to the primary endpoint only

data_description.language: Language passed to the Assist pipeline; leave on “Follow Home Assistant” unless 小艺 speaks a different language than your HA UI
data_description.ha_agent_id: Optional conversation agent ID, e.g. conversation.openai_conversation
data_description.api_id: API ID from the 小艺开放平台, required by the send_push service
data_description.status_updates: Send “processing” and “done” status messages back to 小艺
data_description.heartbeat_interval: Application heartbeat period; the XiaoYi server closes idle connections, so keep it at or below 30s
data_description.reconnect_max: Attempts before the bridge pauses for 15 minutes and tries again
data_description.heartbeat_first_delay: Delay before the first heartbeat after the connection is established (default 1 second). Only raise it when diagnosing disconnects that happen right after connecting.
data_description.single_server: Use only the primary endpoint and fall back to the backup when it is unreachable. Enable it if the platform allows a single session per agent, so two connections do not kick each other.

error.unknown_agent: No Home Assistant conversation agent with this ID exists

send_push.name: Send push notification
send_push.description: Push a notification to 小艺 users out of band, through the XiaoYi agent-webhook. Requires the push API ID and a push ID observed from an incoming 小艺 message.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text carried in the notification body.

push_text.name: Push text
push_text.description: Short notification text shown to the user. Defaults to the first 50 characters of the message.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: XiaoYi session to push to. Defaults to the most recently seen session.

api_id.name: API ID
api_id.description: Overrides the push API ID configured in the integration options.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Targets a specific config entry when several are configured.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Close both A2A WebSocket connections and connect again.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Targets a specific config entry when several are configured.

push_not_configured.message: Push is not configured yet. Missing: {missing}. Set the push API ID in the options, and make sure a 小艺 message has been received so a push ID is known.

push_failed.message: The XiaoYi push webhook did not accept the notification.

unknown_entry.message: No XiaoYi Bridge config entry with ID {entry_id} exists.

entry_not_loaded.message: The XiaoYi Bridge config entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

no_loaded_entry.message: No XiaoYi Bridge config entry is loaded.
